comment: The pinned official DeepSeek Harness baseline for `npm run test:harness`.
The runner extracts the official specs from this exact git ref rather than
from whatever the local checkout has checked out, so the compatibility gate
cannot silently drift with a developer's working tree.
Every official ACP spec file must be classified below. An unclassified file
fails the run: a new official assertion is a review event, not a silent skip.

alignedSpecs.contract: ACP prompt stop-reason vocabulary. Both implementations map a durable turn ending onto the same protocol enum, including max_tokens, so the official assertions run verbatim against src/codec.ts.

divergentSpecs.reason: Uses the official automation-only tests/harness.ts, which composes neither `commands`, `skills`, nor `sessionQuery`. This server injects all three to serve slash commands, skills, and session/load, so its plugin fiber never activates in that harness.

Same automation-only harness limitation as approval.spec.ts. The file also asserts the official surface's absence of session/load, presentation cards, and elicitation, which this editor-facing server advertises.
Same automation-only harness limitation as approval.spec.ts. This repository's own tests/dispose.spec.ts covers connection ownership and quiescence for the composed editor profile.
Same automation-only harness limitation as approval.spec.ts. Covered locally by tests/bridge-edges.spec.ts.
Same automation-only harness limitation as approval.spec.ts. Covered locally by tests/sessions.spec.ts and the built-launcher cross-process session tests.
Same automation-only harness limitation as approval.spec.ts. Covered locally by tests/bridge.spec.ts and tests/schema-conformance.spec.ts.

Imports the official module's private export names `supportsAcpImagePrompts`, `admitAcpPrompt`, `assistantBlockToAcp`, and `AcpContentError`. This repository owns the same protocol behavior under `admitPrompt`, `projectImage`, and `InteractivePromptError` in src/content.ts, plus editor-only concerns the official codec has no counterpart for.

Imports the official `mountAcpMcpServers`. This repository splits the same stdio/HTTP declaration mapping into `mapMcpServers` and `installSessionMcp` so a failed server can roll back a whole session, which tests/mcp.spec.ts covers against real servers.

Imports `../src/model-control.ts`, a module the official package introduced at 0.1.2-rc.1. This repository already served session/set_config_option before that split, from src/config-options.ts and src/index.ts, and encodes model values as an opaque provider:model pair rather than the official JSON tuple. ACP treats the value as opaque, so this is not a protocol difference.

Imports `../src/updates.ts`, another module introduced at 0.1.2-rc.1. This repository projects committed events from src/presentation.ts and src/index.ts, and additionally emits tool-owned cards, diffs, and terminal content that the official projection does not produce.
